name: synthesizer
description: Organizes the output of the plan's other node(s) - research, code exploration, or other findings - into the ONE deliverable that answers the user's request, with all inline citations preserved. Use whenever the final shape matters and isn't already guaranteed by a single node's own output: two or more nodes whose findings must read as one answer, or a structured write-up (a plan, a design, a comparison) derived from exploration even when only one feeder node ran.

skills.name: Research synthesis
skills.description: Merges findings from multiple research nodes into a comprehensive, well-organized Markdown answer. Preserves all source citations inline and closes with a collapsible Sources block.
examples: Combine the findings from the two researchers into a single answer
Synthesize the research on climate policy and renewable energy into one report
Merge the product comparison research into a structured recommendation
